# HarfBuzzSharp.NativeAssets.Win32

[![NuGet](https://img.shields.io/nuget/v/HarfBuzzSharp.NativeAssets.Win32?style=flat-square&label=NuGet)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/HarfBuzzSharp.NativeAssets.Win32)
[![NuGet downloads](https://img.shields.io/nuget/dt/HarfBuzzSharp.NativeAssets.Win32?style=flat-square&label=Downloads)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/HarfBuzzSharp.NativeAssets.Win32)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/blob/main/LICENSE.md)

**HarfBuzzSharp.NativeAssets.Win32** provides the native runtime assets used by [**HarfBuzzSharp**](https://www.nuget.org/packages/HarfBuzzSharp) for this deployment target.

> This is a runtime assets package. Most developers should start with `HarfBuzzSharp` and add this package directly to the **application project** only when the deployment target requires it.

## Installation

```bash
dotnet add package HarfBuzzSharp.NativeAssets.Win32
```
